labels.notes: A refutation, cited unmarked (no **`lem:...`** anywhere in the first 4000 characters; the ledger regex tools/ledger.py:247 finds no mark), REPORT status partial, marked false: correct, since the row's certificate stays DEC-19's cupCapBTZAsPrinted_of_globallyHyperbolic. (1) not_cupCapBTZAsPrinted : ∀ {C : Causality ↥puncture}, SFALocalE0.IsE0Natural C → ¬ C.CupCapBTZAsPrinted (SFALocalE0.sing ↥puncture). It is the strict Prop of Causal/SingularGeroch.lean:326 itself, unfolded by #print: SingularFlatSpacetime sing → StronglyCausal → ∀ p ∈ sing 0, ∀ u, Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 p) → (∀ n, ¬ C.le ⊤ p (u n)) → ⋃ N, ⋂ n ≥ N, Jminus ⊤ {u n} = Jminus ⊤ {p} \ {p}. It is not a variant, and nothing is weakened: the proof discharges both antecedents (singularFlatSpacetime, stronglyCausal) and feeds failure's data to the equation. The sing is the genuine one: SFALocalE0.sing puncture, with sing 0 = Sing(↥puncture), the punctured axis (mem_sing_zero_iff), and sing α = ∅ for α ≠ 0. It is not a sing tailored to break the Prop. (2) The hypotheses at M = E₀ ∖ {w} are the printed lemma's. M is a connected E₀-manifold: e0Covered, through isAEChart_subtypeCoe, and connectedSpace. It is SingularFlatSpacetime, through SFALine.singularFlatAxioms_e0 with the subtype's T2 and second countable instances. It is StronglyCausal in DEC-7's form (stronglyCausal; also StronglyCausalOpen), and its causality is the natural one (IsE0Natural: absolutely minimal, every chart of the maximal atlas and every chart into E₀ a ChartIso), so the kb/0014 loophole is excluded. I checked one claim further by probe: C is also the natural causality over the whole family E_{≥0}, i.e. IsAtlasCausalityDEC25 (Flat.isom 2) C (minkowski 2) massAModelCausality. That follows from MassAModelsInstance.massA_dec25_e0_manifolds' uniqueness clause with hC.2.2 and isoChartsCoverDEC25 hC, and compiles under the file's own imports. So the witness carries 'the causality generated by its X_A-atlas' with A = ℝ₊, in OQ-18's reading. (3) exists_counterexample : ∃ (M : Type) (_ : TopologicalSpace M) (C : Causality M) (sing : ℝ → Set M), SingularFlatSpacetime ∧ StronglyCausal ∧ StronglyCausalOpen ∧ IsCausal ∧ AbsolutelyMinimal ∧ (sing 0).Nonempty ∧ ¬ CupCapBTZAsPrinted sing. Its witness is the genuine one above. not_forall_cupCapBTZAsPrinted negates ∀ M [TopologicalSpace M] C sing, C.CupCapBTZAsPrinted sing. That is the right ∀: the Prop carries the lemma's hypotheses inside it, so this is 'the printed lemma holds for every space'. It is the weaker of the two (sing ranges freely), and the REPORT describes it accurately. The informative anchors are not_cupCapBTZAsPrinted and exists_counterexample. (4) natCausality exists by SFALocalE0.existsUnique_isE0Natural e0Covered, and is unique by the same theorem, which I re-checked by probe. Uniqueness is not load-bearing: not_cupCapBTZAsPrinted holds for every C with IsE0Natural C. (5) The data hold. p = (1,0) is on the axis, hence in sing₀ (mem_sing_zero_iff). p_n = (1, 1/(n+1)) has rad = 1/(n+1) > 0 and tends to p (tendsto_uE). f(p_n) = 1 − rad/2 < 1 = τ(p), so p ≰ p_n (not_le_pE_uE, through E0.le_axis_iff). For z = (−1,0), z ≪ p_n for every n (lt_zE_uE): E0.lt_axis_iff gives the condition f(p_n) ≥ 1/2 > −1, and the segment's radial coordinate is s·r(p_n), so the segment avoids w. z ∉ J⁻(p) ∖ {p}: a causal curve to p stays on the axis, and by the IVT its τ passes 0, i.e. it passes through w ∉ M (not_le_pE_of_fst_nonpos). Jminus_p computes J⁻(p) = {axis, 0 < τ ≤ 1} = ]w, p]. halfLine_subset_diff puts every axis point with τ < 0 in LHS ∖ RHS. not_isClosed_Jplus_z: p_n ∈ J⁺(z), p_n → p, p ∉ J⁺(z). not_globallyHyperbolic is the contrapositive of the certificate, a consistency check with DEC-19. The paper quote in the docstring matches ETT.tex:1826–1829 and 1832 verbatim.

findings_review.note: Both provisos of the by-hand finding are discharged. E₀'s strong causality is E0.stronglyCausal (E0Strong.lean:759), carried to open subsets by stronglyCausal_opens. p ∈ Int J⁺(z) is not used: z ≪ p_n holds for every n directly (lt_zE_uE). The stale texts are: Causal/SingularFlat.lean:104–113, Causal/SingularGeroch.lean:312–325, the row's paper_finding, and a third place the REPORT omits, Causal/SingularGeroch.lean:101–106 ('which the package believes false (by-hand counterexample, Causal.SingularFlat, SCOPE)').

The witness shows that what fails is the closedness of J⁺(z) (not_isClosed_Jplus_z). That is the only hypothesis of cup_cap_BTZ_of_isClosed (SingularFlat.lean:566) beyond SingularPastAt p, which SingularFlatAxioms supplies. The '⊂' of l.1829 is 'z ≤ p_n eventually ⇒ z ≤ p' (z ≠ p is automatic), which closed J⁺(z) gives, for z anywhere in M. The proof of lem:J_int (l.1805–1809) only localises at p in a causally convex chart, so 'the same way' (l.1832) cannot reach z outside it. The REPORT's wording 'exactly the hypothesis' is accurate in that sense.

question: Covered, not open: no OQ-87 is needed. DEC-25 reads an X_A-manifold from model spaces as gx does, with the maximal a.e. atlas and X_A-charts being a.e. isomorphism charts into the models (X_α)_{α∈A}. In that reading the class is monotone in A: a chart into E₀ is an X_{ℝ₊}-chart, so an E₀-manifold is an E_{≥0}-manifold, and l.1500–1505 asks of A = ℝ₊ only that the charts go into E_α, α ≥ 0, not that every α occur. The library already encodes this: SFALocal.sing_eq_of_e0Covered and isoChartsCoverDEC25_of_e0 (Causal/Port/SFALocal.lean:512, 527). MassAModelsInstance.massA_dec25_e0_manifolds (Causal/Remarks/MassAModelsInstance.lean) proves, with no hypothesis, that an E₀-manifold carries the family-natural causality and that it is the only absolutely minimal causality with an isomorphic chart at each point. So the witness's C is that causality (checked by probe). What remains are the existing readings: OQ-18 (open: 'the causality generated by its X_A-atlas' read as the absolutely minimal natural one), OQ-34/OQ-35 (E₀) and OQ-82 (the group), each already disclosed in the file's SCOPE.

findings.what: The checklist's 'hence E_{≥0}-manifold, with its natural causality' and isoChartsCoverDEC25's docstring ('the paper's « singular flat spacetime »', A = ℝ₊) are true. curation.toml, row lem:cup_cap_BTZ, paper_findings: replace the by-hand entry with exactly: "The reason for DEC-19, formalized (Causal/Port/CupCapBTZCounterexample.lean): lem:cup_cap_BTZ as printed (M strongly causal, ETT.tex:1825–1829) is false. Witness: M = E_0 ∖ {w}, w = (0,0) on the BTZ line, with the structure pulled back along the inclusion (opensSingularGXStructure, DEC-25) and its natural causality C (unique, absolutely minimal, causal; by MassAModelsInstance.massA_dec25_e0_manifolds also the natural causality over the whole family E_{≥0}). M is a connected, Hausdorff, second countable E_0-manifold, a singular flat spacetime (SingularFlatSpacetime, sing_0(M) the punctured axis), strongly causal in DEC-7's form and with open neighbourhoods. Causal.CupCapBTZCounterexample.not_cupCapBTZAsPrinted proves ¬ C.CupCapBTZAsPrinted (SFALocalE0.sing M), the strict Prop itself (packaged: exists_counterexample, not_forall_cupCapBTZAsPrinted). Data: p = (1,0) ∈ sing_0(M); p_n = (1, 1/(n+1)) → p, regular, with p ∉ J^-(p_n); z = (−1,0). Then z << p_n for every n: the straight chronal segment from z to p_n meets the axis only at z, so it avoids w. Meanwhile J^-(p) = ]w,p] (Jminus_p). So z, and with it the whole half-line of the axis below w (halfLine_subset_diff), lies in ⋃_N ⋂_{n≥N} J^-(p_n) and not in J^-(p) ∖ {p}. No proviso is left: E_0's strong causality is proved (E0.stronglyCausal) and carried to every open subset, and p ∈ Int J^+(z) is not used. What fails is the closedness of J^+(z) (not_isClosed_Jplus_z), the hypothesis of cup_cap_BTZ_of_isClosed; M is not globally hyperbolic (not_globallyHyperbolic). So the proof 'as for lem:J_int' (l.1832) cannot work. That proof (l.1805–1809) reduces to a chart at p causally convex in M, while the inclusion ⊂ needs z ≤ p_n ⇒ z ≤ p for z outside every such chart, a global property strong causality does not give. The witness is a singular flat spacetime of the paper in the library's readings of E_0 (OQ-34, OQ-35), of its causality (OQ-18) and of the group (OQ-82). Its only use (l.2122) is in a globally hyperbolic setting, where it holds: under DEC-19 the lemma is stated for globally hyperbolic M, its certificate cupCapBTZAsPrinted_of_globallyHyperbolic unchanged, and the printed strongly causal form stays the Prop Causal.Causality.CupCapBTZAsPrinted, now refuted. The certificate's hypotheses hold at a BTZ point, E_0 itself (E0.globallyHyperbolic, E0.singularFlatSpacetime, sing_0 ≠ ∅), but no declaration instantiates it there yet: the timelike line's instance timelikeLine_cupCapBTZAsPrinted is vacuous (sing 0 = ∅)."
